topic_zh: 函数与表达式：最后一行不加分号就是返回值
topic_en: Rust functions and expressions: the last line is the return value

xhs.title: Rust 函数没写 return 也能返回？
xhs.body:
第 4 课：函数与表达式
语句只做事，表达式会算出一个值
最后一行不加分号 → 它就是返回值
多加一个分号 → 返回空元组 ()，直接编译报错
你被这个分号坑过吗？评论区聊聊～

douyin.title: 一个分号，决定 Rust 函数返回什么
douyin.body: 最后一行不加分号就是返回值，加了分号值就没了。

tiktok.body: No return keyword, still returns a value? In Rust, the last line without a semicolon is the return value.

linkedin.title: In Rust, one semicolon decides what a function returns
linkedin.body:
Statements do something; expressions evaluate to a value.
The last expression in a function body, with no semicolon, is the return value.
Add a semicolon and it becomes a statement that yields (), so the types no longer match.
Blocks work the same way, which is why if can be an expression too.
Did this semicolon ever trip you up?
